title: Shopping Reasoning Bench: An Expert-Authored Benchmark for Multi-Turn Conversational Shopping Assistants
title_zh: Shopping Reasoning Bench：面向多轮对话购物助手的专家编写基准
abstract_en: Conversational shopping assistants now serve hundreds of millions of customers, yet no existing benchmark jointly evaluates the open-ended multi-turn reasoning, domain expertise, and criterion-level quality that real shopping conversations demand. Shopping reasoning is unique among language model applications. Unlike factual question answering or verifiable code generation, it requires balancing subjective preferences, budget constraints, and cross-product trade-offs across multi-turn dialogue, capabilities absent from previous e-commerce and general-purpose benchmarks. We introduce the Shopping Reasoning Bench, an expert-authored benchmark of 525 missions (232 single-turn, 293 multi-turn) with 10863 importance-weighted binary rubrics authored by retail domain experts. These criteria are organized under a taxonomy of five reasoning categories and fifteen subcategories covering diverse demands such as preference refinement, trade-off analysis, and compatibility assessment. An evaluation of nine models across three families (GPT, Claude, Gemini) shows that pass rates reach only 57--77% overall. On multi-turn missions, all models score 13--29 points lower on optional above-and-beyond criteria than on required ones, and performance degrades 4--18 points as conversations progress. These gaps show that current models handle basic shopping assistance but fall short of expert-level advice, making Shopping Reasoning Bench a challenging testbed for future shopping assistant development.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Shopping Reasoning Bench，一个用于评估多轮对话购物助手的专家编写基准。现有基准难以同时覆盖真实购物场景所需的开放式多轮推理、零售领域知识与细粒度质量评估。该基准包含 525 个购物任务，其中 232 个为单轮任务、293 个为多轮任务，并配有 10863 条由零售领域专家编写、带重要性权重的二元评分准则。这些准则被组织为 5 类推理能力与 15 个子类，覆盖偏好澄清、权衡分析、兼容性判断等需求。作者评估了 GPT、Claude、Gemini 三个模型家族共 9 个模型，整体通过率仅为 57%–77%。在多轮任务中，所有模型在可选的“超预期”准则上比必需准则低 13–29 分，且随着对话推进性能下降 4–18 分，说明当前模型虽能完成基础购物辅助，但距离专家级建议仍有明显差距。
key_points_zh: Shopping Reasoning Bench 聚焦真实购物对话中的多轮推理、主观偏好、预算约束与跨商品权衡，补足现有电商和通用基准的空白。
基准包含 525 个任务与 10863 条重要性加权的二元 rubrics，全部由零售领域专家编写，支持细粒度质量评估。
评估体系覆盖 5 大推理类别和 15 个子类别，包括 preference refinement、trade-off analysis、compatibility assessment 等核心购物能力。
在 GPT、Claude、Gemini 三个家族的 9 个模型上，整体通过率仅为 57%–77%，显示当前主流模型仍难达到专家级购物助手水平。
多轮场景下模型表现明显退化：可选高质量准则得分低于必需准则 13–29 分，且随对话推进下降 4–18 分。

llm_assessment.comment: Excellent commerce-grounded benchmark for conversational shopping assistants with strong relevance to real product advice and decision support.
